description: Current Workday regions by country code for the Address Country Code -> Region cascading picklist. Built from the 3+ workbook's 'Country States-Regions' sheet. Rows marked obsolete in the workbook are excluded. Rows are grouped by country_code so each country subset can become one Excel named range.
provenance: Snapshot copied 2026-07-21 from FIN Master Supplier Workbook Instructions.xlsx ('Country States-Regions' sheet), joined by exact country name to implementations/elt_transform_excel/config/ingest_lookups/ref_country.json for ISO2 country_code. Excludes rows whose Instance contains '(obsolete)'. This snapshot covers 84 ref_country codes; the workbook contains no region rows for these ref_country names: Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Curaçao, Gibraltar, Guernsey, Holy See (Vatican City State), Isle of Man, Jersey, Macao, Micronesia, Federated States of, Monaco, North Macedonia, Puerto Rico, Reunion, Saint Barthelemy, Saint Martin, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, Sao Tome and Principe, Sint Maarten, Timor-Leste, U. S. Virgin Islands, Åland Islands. A COPY, not a link.
